correctness.rationale: Exact counting gives the joint mass matrix of the minimum and maximum for three iid uniform draws on four points. For the strictly increasing family \(g_a=(0,a,1-a,1)\), exact moment algebra gives \(\operatorname{Corr}=(-7a^2+4a+4)/(95a^2-68a+28)\). Subtraction of the raw value \(41/143\) factors as \(-96(3a-1)(17a-6)/(143(95a^2-68a+28))\); the denominator is positive because its discriminant is negative. Thus strict improvement holds exactly for \(1/3<a<6/17\). Differentiation gives the unique within-family optimizer \(a=6-4\sqrt2\). The packaged verifier independently checks the finite counting and polynomial identities with exact rational arithmetic.

value.rationale: The finding overturns a stated general same-transform correlation relation in the first four-point, three-sample extreme-order case. The failure is robust on the full interval \(1/3<a<6/17\) rather than being a numerical point anomaly, and the family has an exact internal optimizer.
